description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the four-layer memory architecture (short-term → memory/short-term/, episodic → memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md via memlog.sh, semantic → memory/semantic/, long-term → MEMORY.md). (2) Invoke `memlog.sh 'Title' 'Content'` to write episodic entries for sessions from interaction_log_001.txt and interaction_log_002.txt. (3) Create files in memory/short-term/ with `temperature: Hot` (or Warm/Cold) frontmatter/tags for current-session working data. (4) Populate memory/semantic/ with extracted facts from semantic_facts_dump.txt and the interaction logs. (5) Write a curated summary to MEMORY.md at the workspace root. (6) Identify facts with confidence < 50% (DataStream Pro vendor name at 35%, pricing at 40%, retention window at 30%) and write explicit clarification-request flags in memory/confidence/ or equivalent. (7) Create a file in emotions/ capturing the user's stress/deadline anxiety detected in interaction_log_001.txt. (8) Decompose project_brief_alpha.txt into ≥3 tracked subtasks written into the tasks/ directory with status tracking. (9) Write at least one reflection entry in reflections/. The proprietary traps are: the exact directory layout (especially memory/short-term/, memory/semantic/, memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md, memory/confidence/), the Hot/Warm/Cold temperature labels on short-term entries, and the <50% confidence threshold triggering explicit clarification flags — none of which are guessable from general knowledge.
